decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - A schedule for all new windows, doors, architraves and rooflight at scale 1:2o (or as appropriate) shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 3 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.
Condition : 4 - A sample roof tile showing the proposed colour and texture shall be provided on site and approved in writing before the commencement of works.
Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until the external appearance of the elevation (facing Rupert Road) has been agreed and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, or vents shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the approved drawings.
description: Erection of single storey swimming enclosure building in rear garden of existing dwellinghouse.
